additions.type: SPI prototype board versus compact camera assembly
additions.board_name: Arducam New 2MP Mini SPI Camera B006701
additions.bare_name: Arducam M0031 OV2640 compact camera module with lens and 24-pin FPC (not a bare image-sensor die)
additions.notes: B006701 is a 34 x 24 x 16.8 mm, up-to-0.7 W camera with SPI image stream, I2C configuration and onboard 8 MB buffer; manufacturer lists $25.99 and Add to Cart. M0031 is a $6.99 smaller lens/FPC camera assembly with OV2640 on-chip ISP/JPEG, but presents 24-pin parallel DVP, so it is not a drop-in substitute for the SPI board. Bare OV2640 die has no verified public current USD price here; obtain an OEM quote if a die-only BOM is required. Confirm MCU pins, throughput, firmware, lens placement and power before selection. M0031 page price verified, checkout stock not established.

additions.type: Matched breakout versus LGA biometric system component
additions.board_name: SparkFun FPC2534 Qwiic fingerprint breakout SEN-29854
additions.bare_name: Fingerprint Cards FPC2534AP AllKey Pro LGA, DigiKey 100026223
additions.notes: The 25.4 x 25.4 mm SparkFun board is in stock and includes the FPC2534 biometric system, connectors, voltage regulation and support circuitry; $53.96 each at 25+ units. DigiKey lists the matched 47-pin LGA part in stock at $23.85 each, $20.1156 each at 25+; this is a packaged sensor/processor system, not an optical raw die or ready-to-wire module. Manufacturer also offers FPC2534AM flex module at $29.81 single-unit, but its integration cost differs. Cheaper prototype-only alternative: Adafruit 4690 optical UART fingerprint module $19.95 (https://www.adafruit.com/product/4690), but it is a different and bulkier assembly with no verified matched bare-part price. Biometric matching alone does not certify or authorize payment transactions; payment integration/security remains a separate system requirement.

additions.type: Finished photovoltaic panel versus custom cell/panel sourcing
additions.board_name: Voltaic P122 5 V-class 0.3 W ETFE solar panel, Adafruit 5855
additions.bare_name: Custom photovoltaic cell or smaller shaped panel (quote required; a solar panel is not an IC)
additions.notes: Finished panel is listed in stock at $5.95, 52 x 52 x 3.1 mm with solder pads. Vendor lists about 5.9 V and 50 mA at maximum power under rated illumination; 0.3 W is a peak outdoor rating, not an indoor charging guarantee. At 52 mm square it may be too large for a compact wearable face; enclosure area, orientation and actual light exposure must be measured. There is no honest chip-only equivalent or verified custom-panel unit price.

additions.feature: Onboard solar charging and power path
additions.type: Solar charger development board versus charger IC
additions.notes: Board in stock at $14.95 ($13.46 at 10+). It is intended for 6-7 V solar panels and includes connectors, power path and support circuitry. The P122 nominal 5 V-class panel has about 5.9 V at maximum power, so it is a plausible electrical pairing requiring bench verification at only ~50 mA peak. DigiKey lists BQ24074 IC at $2.43 each, $1.6496 at 25+; bare IC also needs a custom PCB, passives, connectors, battery protection and charge-current design. Solar is supplementary unless an actual energy budget proves otherwise.
